title.zh: Crypto stocks sink after Senate rejects Clarity Act
title.en: Crypto stocks sink after Senate rejects Clarity Act

current_state.zh: Crypto-linked equities including Coinbase, Circle, and Galaxy fell more than 8% after the U.S. Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act market structure bill by a 49-50 vote.
current_state.en: Crypto-linked equities including Coinbase, Circle, and Galaxy fell more than 8% after the U.S. Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act market structure bill by a 49-50 vote.
